purpose: Reproducible integrated snapshot for the overseas Japanese-player tracker after verified August 20 European-match updates, competition-scoped aggregate UI fixes, Premier League Japanese-player roster corrections, Ko Itakura's confirmed return to Borussia Monchengladbach, API-Football manifest synchronization, Kaoru Mitoma's current injury availability and squad-number updates, and Eintracht Frankfurt's verified DFB-Pokal opener with Keita Kosugi's corrected three assists and Ritsu Doan's muscular-complaint absence.
verifiedCorrections: Sint-Truidense 1-0 Omonia on 2026-08-20 added as a UEFA Europa League play-off first leg; Shogo Taniguchi scored the 90+4 winner.

STVV Japanese participation recorded from the available match report: Leo Brian Kokubo, Shogo Taniguchi, Nelson Ishiwatari and Kaito Matsuzawa started; Ryotaro Araki entered at 61 minutes; Ishiwatari and Matsuzawa left at 61.
Motherwell 1-3 Freiburg records refined: Keisuke Goto entered at 80 minutes and scored at 90+6; Yuito Suzuki started and left at 74 minutes.

SC St. Tonis 0-11 Eintracht Frankfurt on 2026-08-21 added as a DFB-Pokal first-round result; Keita Kosugi started and is now credited with three assists, at 29, 34 and 45+5 minutes. The earlier two-assist record is retained as an explicit source conflict and superseded by the higher-priority structured event feed.
Ritsu Doan was absent from Eintracht Frankfurt's 2026-08-21 DFB-Pokal squad because of muscular complaints; no appearance record or zero match statistics were created for him.

Premier League roster correction: Hidemasa Morita is registered with Hull City, Tatsuhiro Sakamoto with Coventry City, and Takehiro Tomiyasu with Crystal Palace for 2026-27; all three were missing from the integrated player list.
Ko Itakura transferred from Ajax back to Borussia Monchengladbach on 2026-08-20; the Bundesliga membership is recorded as a transfer while preserving Ajax/Eredivisie as the previous membership.
Kaoru Mitoma's current player status reflects his verified hamstring surgery and current injury absence instead of the generic pre-season status; no league appearance statistics were changed.
Brighton officially registered Kaoru Mitoma as squad number 7 for 2026/27, replacing his previous number 22; the player master now retains squadNumber=7.
Competition-specific aggregates remain linked to matchId/playerMatchStats so goals are traceable to the competition and match rather than existing only as a merged total.
Runtime ranking scope reads competitionStats for league/competition filters and allCompetitionsStats only for the all-competitions view; player detail exposes a competition breakdown.

The retained snapshot mirrors the current backfill manifest including api-football-existing-results.json, latest-2026-08-21-5.json, latest-2026-08-22.json, latest-2026-08-22-2.json and latest-2026-08-22-3.json.
